scenario: 评估设计里，除了地区/设备这类运营切片，还要考虑种族/性别等受保护群体。
scenario_en: Beyond operational slices like region/device, the evaluation must also consider protected groups like race/gender.
q: fairness-aware evaluation 相对切片评估扩展了什么，为什么要前置到设计阶段？
q_en: How does fairness-aware evaluation extend slice-based evaluation, and why front-load it to design?
why: 它把切片从运营 segment（设备/地区）扩展到受保护的人口学群体，用有法律含义的正式公平指标衡量。要前置成设计需求而非上线后补救，因为监管（EEOC/ECOA/EU AI Act）要求非歧视性影响的证据，事后修代价高。
why_en: It extends slices from operational segments to protected demographic groups with formal fairness metrics, making fairness a design requirement because regulators demand evidence of non-discriminatory impact.
options: 把切片扩展到更多设备型号，用同样的运营指标衡量，和监管无关
把切片扩展到受保护人口学群体，用有法律含义的公平指标衡量，前置为设计需求
只在模型上线后收到投诉时再做一次性的公平审计
把所有群体合并成一个总体准确率来证明模型『对大家都好』
options_en: Extend slices to more device models, measured by the same operational metrics, unrelated to regulation.
Extend slices to protected demographic groups with legally-meaningful fairness metrics, front-loaded as a design requirement.
Only run a one-off fairness audit after launch when complaints come in.
Merge all groups into one overall accuracy to prove the model is 'good for everyone'.
optionExplanations: 只加设备型号还停在运营切片，没触及『受保护群体 + 正式公平指标 + 监管』这三个新维度。
对；核心是从运营 segment 升到受保护群体，用正式公平指标，并把公平当设计需求前置。
上线后再审计正是它要取代的『post-launch fix』心态，监管要的是设计阶段就有证据。
合并成总准确率恰好会淹没群体间差异，是公平评估要打破的均值陷阱。
optionExplanations_en: Adding device models stays at operational slices, missing the three new axes: protected groups, formal fairness metrics, and regulation.
Correct — the core is elevating from operational segments to protected groups with formal fairness metrics, front-loaded as a design requirement.
Auditing after launch is the very 'post-launch fix' mindset it replaces; regulators want design-stage evidence.
Merging into overall accuracy drowns inter-group differences — the average trap fairness evaluation breaks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 法律上受反歧视保护的人口学群体（种族、性别、年龄等）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A protected group is a demographic (race, gender, age, etc.) legally shielded from discrimination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 欧盟的 AI 监管法规，对高风险 AI 系统要求非歧视性等合规证据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The EU AI Act is the European Union's AI regulation requiring compliance evidence such as non-discrimination for high-risk AI systems.

scenario: 做广告投放系统，希望不同人口学群体看到某类广告的机会均等。
scenario_en: Building an ad delivery system, you want equal opportunity to see a category of ads across demographic groups.
q: demographic parity（人口学均等）度量的是什么？
q_en: What does demographic parity measure?
why: demographic parity 要求各群体的正预测率相等：P(Ŷ=1|G=a) = P(Ŷ=1|G=b)。它只看预测、不看真实标签，适合『机会均等投放』这类不依赖真值的场景（如广告平权投放）。
why_en: Demographic parity requires equal positive-prediction rates across groups, ignoring true labels, which fits equitable ad delivery.
options: 各群体在真实为正的样本上被判为正的比例相等（等 TPR）
各群体的正预测率相等 P(Ŷ=1|G=a)=P(Ŷ=1|G=b)，只看预测不看真实标签
各群体的整体准确率相等
各群体被误判为正的比例相等（等 FPR）
options_en: Equal rate of predicting positive among the truly-positive of each group (equal TPR).
Equal positive-prediction rate across groups, P(Ŷ=1|G=a)=P(Ŷ=1|G=b), looking only at predictions, not true labels.
Equal overall accuracy across groups.
Equal rate of falsely predicting positive across groups (equal FPR).
optionExplanations: 这是 equal opportunity（条件在真实为正上等 TPR），不是 demographic parity。
对；demographic parity 只比正预测率、不涉真值，故适合广告平权投放这种不依赖标签的目标。
等准确率不是任何一个标准公平定义，且准确率会掩盖正预测率的群体差异。
等 FPR 是 equalized odds 的一半，不是 demographic parity。
optionExplanations_en: That's equal opportunity (equal TPR conditioned on truly-positive), not demographic parity.
Correct — demographic parity compares only positive-prediction rates, ignoring truth, so it fits label-independent goals like equitable ad delivery.
Equal accuracy is no standard fairness definition and would mask group differences in positive rates.
Equal FPR is half of equalized odds, not demographic parity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 各群体获得正预测的比例相等，不考虑真实标签。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Demographic parity means equal positive-prediction rates across groups, regardless of true labels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型输出的预测类别（Ŷ=1 表示预测为正）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ŷ is the model's predicted label, with Ŷ=1 meaning predicted positive.

scenario: 招聘筛选模型，要保证『合格候选人』无论属于哪个群体，被通过的比例都相等。
scenario_en: A hiring-screen model must ensure qualified candidates pass at equal rates regardless of group.
q: 该用哪个公平指标，它约束的是什么？
q_en: Which fairness metric applies, and what does it constrain?
why: 用 equal opportunity：各群体在真实合格（Y=1）者中的 TPR 相等，即『合格者的召回率一致』。它正好对应招聘目标——只要你合格，通过率就不该因群体不同，而不管不合格者怎样。
why_en: Use equal opportunity — equal TPR across groups among the truly-qualified (Y=1), matching hiring's goal of equal recall among the qualified.
tradeoff: equal opportunity（约束合格者召回一致）vs demographic parity（约束总体通过率一致，可能通过不合格者凑数）
whenOtherWins: 如果目标是『各群体获得机会的总量相等』而不管是否合格（如平权广告曝光），那 demographic parity 更合适。
options: demographic parity：让各群体的总体通过率相等，不看是否合格
equal opportunity：各群体在真实合格者(Y=1)中的 TPR 相等，即合格者召回一致
calibration：让预测概率在各群体上都校准
整体准确率最大化：只要总准确率高就算公平
options_en: Demographic parity: equal overall pass rate across groups, ignoring qualification.
Equal opportunity: equal TPR across groups among the truly-qualified (Y=1), i.e. equal recall among the qualified.
Calibration: make predicted probabilities well-calibrated within each group.
Maximize overall accuracy: high total accuracy counts as fair.
optionExplanations: demographic parity 不看合格与否，可能为凑通过率而放过不合格者，偏离『合格者一视同仁』。
对；equal opportunity 条件在 Y=1 上等 TPR，精确对应『只要合格，通过率不因群体而异』。
calibration 管的是概率可信度，不直接保证合格者的通过率跨群体一致。
最大化总准确率与公平无关，反而常靠牺牲少数群体换取总分。
optionExplanations_en: Demographic parity ignores qualification and may pass unqualified candidates to hit a rate, straying from equal treatment of the qualified.
Correct — equal opportunity equalizes TPR conditioned on Y=1, exactly 'if qualified, pass rate shouldn't vary by group'.
Calibration governs probability trustworthiness, not directly equal pass rates among the qualified across groups.
Maximizing overall accuracy is unrelated to fairness and often trades away minority groups for the total.

termDefinitions.meaning: 各群体在真实为正者中的真正例率(TPR)相等，即合格者召回一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Equal opportunity means equal true-positive rate across groups among the truly-positive — equal recall for the qualified.

termDefinitions.meaning: 真正例率：真实为正中被判为正的比例，等于 recall。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TPR (True Positive Rate) is the fraction of truly-positive cases predicted positive, equal to recall.

scenario: 信贷/刑事风险评估里，误报（把好人标成高风险）会造成实质伤害，光保证合格者召回一致不够。
scenario_en: In lending/criminal-justice risk, false flags (labeling a good person high-risk) cause real harm, so equal recall alone isn't enough.
q: 该用哪个更严格的公平指标？
q_en: Which stricter fairness metric applies?
why: 用 equalized odds：在 equal opportunity（等 TPR）基础上再要求各群体 FPR 也相等。因为在信贷/刑事场景，误报会伤害无辜者，必须同时约束『漏批合格者』和『误标好人』两端。
why_en: Use equalized odds — equal opportunity plus equal FPR — because in lending/criminal justice false flags harm innocents, so both TPR and FPR must be equalized.
tradeoff: equalized odds（等 TPR 且等 FPR，最严）vs equal opportunity（只等 TPR，忽略误报差异）
whenOtherWins: 如果误报几乎无害、只关心合格者是否被公平通过（如某些低风险推荐），equal opportunity 更简单也够用。
options: demographic parity，只要正预测率相等就行
equalized odds：equal opportunity（等 TPR）+ 各群体 FPR 也相等，同时约束漏批与误标
只看整体 AUC 在各群体是否接近
counterfactual fairness，直接换掉因果模型
options_en: Demographic parity — equal positive-prediction rates suffice.
Equalized odds: equal opportunity (equal TPR) plus equal FPR across groups, constraining both missed approvals and false flags.
Just check whether overall AUC is close across groups.
Counterfactual fairness — swap out the causal model directly.
optionExplanations: demographic parity 不约束 FPR，无法防止某群体被系统性误标高风险的伤害。
对；equalized odds 同时等 TPR 和 FPR，正好覆盖信贷/刑事里『误报伤害无辜』的关切。
等 AUC 是排序能力接近，不等于操作点上的 TPR/FPR 公平，不能替代 equalized odds。
counterfactual fairness 是因果视角的另一条路，需要完整因果图，不是这里最直接的度量选择。
optionExplanations_en: Demographic parity doesn't constrain FPR and can't prevent a group being systematically mislabeled high-risk.
Correct — equalized odds equalizes both TPR and FPR, covering the lending/criminal concern that false flags harm the innocent.
Equal AUC is close ranking ability, not operating-point TPR/FPR fairness, and can't replace equalized odds.
Counterfactual fairness is a causal-lens alternative needing a full causal graph, not the most direct metric choice here.

termDefinitions.meaning: 各群体的真正例率(TPR)和假正例率(FPR)都相等，比 equal opportunity 更严。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Equalized odds requires equal TPR and equal FPR across groups, stricter than equal opportunity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 假正例率：真实为负中被误判为正的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FPR (False Positive Rate) is the fraction of truly-negative cases wrongly predicted positive.

scenario: 广告系统用预测概率直接决定出价（bid），概率的可信度对每个群体都关键。
scenario_en: An ad system uses predicted probabilities to set bids, so probability trustworthiness matters for every group.
q: 当概率驱动定价时，最该保证哪种群体公平？
q_en: When probabilities drive pricing, which group fairness matters most?
why: 用跨群体校准（calibration across groups）：对每个群体，在预测置信度 p 的样本里真实为正的比例应等于 p。概率直接算出价时，若某群体的 p 系统性偏高/偏低，出价就会被扭曲，所以校准是核心。
why_en: Use calibration across groups — for each group, among predictions at confidence p the truly-positive fraction equals p — because probabilities driving bids must be trustworthy per group.
tradeoff: 跨群体校准（概率可信、出价不失真）vs equalized odds（约束 TPR/FPR，但两者不可同时满足）
whenOtherWins: 如果下游只用『是/否』的硬判定、不用概率大小（如纯准入门槛），那 equalized odds 这类基于判定的指标比校准更相关。
options: demographic parity，让各群体正预测率相等
跨群体校准：每个群体里置信度 p 的样本真实为正比例 = p，保证概率可信、出价不失真
整体 log-loss 最小，概率越尖锐越好
equal opportunity，只保证合格者召回一致
options_en: Demographic parity — equal positive-prediction rates across groups.
Calibration across groups: within each group, the truly-positive fraction at confidence p equals p, keeping probabilities trustworthy and bids undistorted.
Minimize overall log-loss — the sharper the probabilities the better.
Equal opportunity — only equal recall among the qualified.
optionExplanations: demographic parity 只管正预测率，不保证概率数值本身可信，出价照样可能被扭曲。
对；出价 = 概率驱动，只有跨群体校准才保证每个群体的 p 都名副其实，定价才公平。
log-loss 低是整体拟合好，不等于每个群体都校准，仍可能某群体系统性偏差。
equal opportunity 管判定层的召回，不直接保证概率数值的可信度。
optionExplanations_en: Demographic parity governs only positive rates, not the probability values' trustworthiness, so bids can still be distorted.
Correct — bids are probability-driven, so only calibration across groups makes each group's p mean what it says, keeping pricing fair.
Low log-loss is good overall fit, not per-group calibration; a group can still be systematically off.
Equal opportunity governs decision-level recall, not directly the trustworthiness of probability values.

termDefinitions.term: calibration across groups / 跨群体校准
termDefinitions.meaning: 对每个群体，预测置信度 p 的样本中真实为正的比例都等于 p。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Calibration across groups means that for every group, among predictions at confidence p the truly-positive fraction equals p.

scenario: 信贷模型里各群体的基础违约率（base rate）不同，产品同时想要『跨群体校准』和『各群体 FPR 相等』。
scenario_en: In a lending model, groups have different base rates, and the product wants both per-group calibration AND equal FPR.
q: 同时要 calibration 和 equalized odds，可行吗？
q_en: Can you have both calibration and equalized odds at once?
why: 不可行——这是公平性的不可能定理：除非退化情形（各群体 base rate 相等，或模型完美），否则 calibration 和 equalized odds 无法同时满足。base rate 不同就注定二选一，这是要和利益相关者摊开讲的 staff 级取舍。
why_en: No — the impossibility result says that except in degenerate cases (equal base rates or perfect accuracy), calibration and equalized odds cannot both hold.
options: 可行，只要调好阈值两个都能满足
不可行：除非退化情形（base rate 相等或模型完美），calibration 与 equalized odds 无法同时满足
可行，calibration 天然蕴含 equalized odds
只有样本足够大时才不可行，加数据就能同时满足
options_en: Yes — with the right threshold both can be satisfied.
No: except in degenerate cases (equal base rates or perfect accuracy), calibration and equalized odds cannot both hold.
Yes — calibration automatically implies equalized odds.
It's only impossible with small samples; more data lets both hold.
optionExplanations: 调阈值改的是操作点，改变不了这个数学上的不可能性——base rate 不同时二者互斥。
对；这是经典不可能定理，base rate 不同就必须在 calibration 和 equalized odds 之间选，是 staff 级取舍。
calibration 不蕴含 equalized odds，二者恰恰在非退化情形下冲突。
与样本量无关——这是分布层面的数学结论，加数据不能绕过。
optionExplanations_en: Tuning the threshold moves the operating point but can't defeat the mathematical impossibility — under unequal base rates they're mutually exclusive.
Correct — the classic impossibility result: with unequal base rates you must choose between calibration and equalized odds, a staff-level tradeoff.
Calibration doesn't imply equalized odds; they conflict precisely in non-degenerate cases.
It's independent of sample size — a distributional math result that more data can't bypass.

termDefinitions.meaning: 某群体中真实为正的比例（如某群体的真实违约率）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The base rate is the fraction of truly-positive cases in a group (e.g. its true default rate).

termDefinitions.meaning: 非退化情形下（base rate 不等且模型不完美），calibration 与 equalized odds 不能同时满足。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The impossibility result states that in non-degenerate cases, calibration and equalized odds cannot be satisfied simultaneously.

scenario: 要向产品解释 demographic parity 和 equal opportunity 到底差在哪。
scenario_en: You must explain to product exactly how demographic parity and equal opportunity differ.
q: demographic parity 与 equal opportunity 的关键区别是什么？
q_en: What's the key difference between demographic parity and equal opportunity?
why: 关键差在『是否条件于真实标签』：demographic parity 只看预测的正例率、无视真值；equal opportunity 条件在真实为正(Y=1)上等 TPR。前者管『机会总量均等』，后者管『合格者被公平对待』。
why_en: The key difference is conditioning on truth: demographic parity ignores labels and equalizes positive rates, while equal opportunity equalizes TPR among the truly-positive.
tradeoff: demographic parity（不看真值、机会总量均等）vs equal opportunity（条件在 Y=1、合格者召回均等）
options: 两者相同，只是叫法不同
demographic parity 不看真实标签只等正预测率；equal opportunity 条件在 Y=1 上等 TPR
demographic parity 更严格，蕴含 equal opportunity
equal opportunity 不看真实标签，demographic parity 才看
options_en: They're the same, just different names.
Demographic parity ignores true labels and equalizes positive rates; equal opportunity equalizes TPR conditioned on Y=1.
Demographic parity is stricter and implies equal opportunity.
Equal opportunity ignores true labels, and demographic parity is the one that uses them.
optionExplanations: 两者不同：一个无视真值、一个条件于真值，适用目标也不同。
对；一句话记：parity 不看标签（机会均等），opportunity 看标签（合格者召回均等）。
parity 不蕴含 opportunity，二者独立、常无法同时满足。
说反了：equal opportunity 才条件于真实标签，demographic parity 无视标签。
optionExplanations_en: They differ: one ignores truth, one conditions on it, and they fit different goals.
Correct — mnemonic: parity ignores labels (equal chances), opportunity uses labels (equal recall among qualified).
Parity doesn't imply opportunity; they're independent and often can't both hold.
Reversed: equal opportunity conditions on true labels, while demographic parity ignores them.

scenario: 要判断模型对某个『具体个人』是否公平，而不只是群体统计。
scenario_en: You want to judge whether the model is fair to a specific individual, not just group statistics.
q: counterfactual fairness（反事实公平）问的是什么？
q_en: What does counterfactual fairness ask?
why: 它问：若这个具体个人本属于另一个群体、其他一切不变，预测会不会改变？形式化为 do(A=a) 下的预测等于 do(A=b) 下的预测。需要因果图：受保护属性 A → 中介（zip code、教育）→ 特征。
why_en: It asks whether a specific individual's prediction would change had they belonged to another group, all else equal, formalized as prediction under do(A=a) equals do(A=b).
options: 各群体的平均预测是否相等
若这个具体个人属于另一群体、其他不变，预测是否改变：do(A=a) 与 do(A=b) 下预测相等
去掉受保护属性特征后准确率是否下降
各群体的 FPR 是否相等
options_en: Whether the average prediction is equal across groups.
Whether a specific individual's prediction would change had they belonged to another group, all else equal: prediction under do(A=a) equals do(A=b).
Whether accuracy drops after removing the protected-attribute feature.
Whether FPR is equal across groups.
optionExplanations: 平均预测相等是群体统计（如 demographic parity），不是反事实公平的个体因果问法。
对；反事实公平是个体层面的因果问句，用 do-operator 比较『换个群体身份』下的预测。
去掉属性看准确率是 fairness through unawareness 的思路，反事实公平恰恰指出它不够。
等 FPR 是 equalized odds 的组成，不是反事实公平的因果定义。
optionExplanations_en: Equal average predictions is group statistics (like demographic parity), not the individual causal question of counterfactual fairness.
Correct — counterfactual fairness is an individual-level causal question using the do-operator to compare predictions across a swapped group identity.
Dropping the attribute to check accuracy is the fairness-through-unawareness idea, which counterfactual fairness shows is insufficient.
Equal FPR is part of equalized odds, not the causal definition of counterfactual fairness.

termDefinitions.meaning: 若个体属于另一群体、其余不变，预测不应改变，用因果 do-operator 定义。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Counterfactual fairness requires that an individual's prediction not change had they belonged to another group, defined via the causal do-operator.

termDefinitions.meaning: 因果干预记号：强制把属性 A 设为 a，看结果分布如何变化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: do(A=a) is the causal intervention operator that forces attribute A to value a and examines the resulting distribution.

scenario: 有人提议『把种族这个特征删掉，模型看不到就公平了』（fairness through unawareness）。
scenario_en: Someone proposes 'just drop the race feature; if the model can't see it, it's fair' (fairness through unawareness).
q: 只删掉受保护属性特征，为什么不足以保证公平？
q_en: Why is dropping the protected-attribute feature not enough for fairness?
why: 因为代理特征会携带同样的信号：zip code、收入、教育等与受保护属性高度相关，模型照样能从它们重建群体身份。删一个属性只是掩耳盗铃，真正要做的是移除位于因果路径上的代理特征。
why_en: Proxies like zip code, income, and education carry the same signal, so the model reconstructs group membership even after the attribute is dropped.
options: 删掉后模型就完全公平了，没有任何残留信号
代理特征（zip code、收入、教育）携带同样信号，模型仍能重建群体身份
删掉会让准确率暴跌，所以不该删
删掉属性会违反监管，法律不允许
options_en: After dropping it the model is fully fair with no residual signal.
Proxy features (zip code, income, education) carry the same signal, so the model still reconstructs group membership.
Dropping it crashes accuracy, so you shouldn't drop it.
Dropping the attribute violates regulation, which the law forbids.
optionExplanations: 残留信号恰恰存在——代理特征让『看不见属性』变成假象。
对；zip code/收入等代理和属性强相关，删一个属性挡不住模型从代理重建身份。
准确率不是这里的关键，关键是代理泄漏让 unawareness 失效。
删属性本身不违规，问题在于它不解决歧视，代理仍在泄漏。
optionExplanations_en: Residual signal is exactly the issue — proxies make 'not seeing the attribute' an illusion.
Correct — proxies like zip code/income correlate strongly with the attribute, so dropping one attribute doesn't stop reconstruction from proxies.
Accuracy isn't the point here; the point is proxy leakage defeats unawareness.
Dropping the attribute isn't itself illegal; the problem is it doesn't fix discrimination while proxies still leak.

termDefinitions.term: fairness through unawareness / 无意识公平
termDefinitions.meaning: 以为删掉受保护属性特征就公平；因代理特征泄漏而不足。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fairness through unawareness is the flawed idea that dropping the protected attribute yields fairness, undermined by proxy leakage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 与受保护属性高度相关、能间接携带其信号的特征（zip code、收入等）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A proxy feature correlates strongly with a protected attribute and indirectly carries its signal (e.g. zip code, income).

scenario: 想在实践中逼近反事实公平，但拿不到完整的因果模型（现实里几乎总是这样）。
scenario_en: You want to approximate counterfactual fairness in practice but lack a complete causal model (almost always the case).
q: 拿不到完整因果图时，实践中怎么逼近反事实公平？
q_en: Without a full causal graph, how do you approximate counterfactual fairness in practice?
why: 近似做法：移除位于『受保护属性 → 特征』因果路径上的特征（即那些主要因群体身份而携带信号的代理）。它不完美，但比只删属性强，且在面试里能体现因果推理的 staff 级信号。
why_en: Approximate by removing features on the causal path from the protected attribute — the proxies that carry signal mainly because of group identity.
tradeoff: 移除因果路径上的代理特征（近似反事实公平，损失部分预测力）vs 保留全部特征（预测力高但携带歧视信号）
whenOtherWins: 如果确实能构建可信的完整因果模型，就该用完整反事实公平推断，而不是这种删代理的粗近似。
options: 干脆放弃反事实公平，只用群体统计指标
移除位于『受保护属性→特征』因果路径上的代理特征，作为近似
把受保护属性作为特征加回去，让模型显式建模它
随机扰动所有特征，用噪声抹掉群体信号
options_en: Just abandon counterfactual fairness and use group statistics only.
Remove proxy features that lie on the causal path from the protected attribute to features, as an approximation.
Add the protected attribute back as a feature so the model models it explicitly.
Randomly perturb all features to wash out group signal with noise.
optionExplanations: 放弃就丢了个体因果视角；实践里可以近似而非全盘放弃。
对；删掉因果路径上的代理是可操作的近似，比只删属性更接近反事实公平。
把属性加回去让模型显式用它，方向反了，会强化而非消除歧视路径。
随机扰动会同时破坏有效信号、且不针对因果路径，不是有依据的近似。
optionExplanations_en: Abandoning loses the individual causal lens; you can approximate rather than give up entirely.
Correct — removing proxies on the causal path is an actionable approximation, closer to counterfactual fairness than dropping the attribute alone.
Adding the attribute back for explicit use is backwards, reinforcing rather than removing the discriminatory path.
Random perturbation destroys useful signal and doesn't target the causal path — not a principled approximation.

scenario: 模型已训练好、上线服务中，想加入公平校准但不想重训整个模型。
scenario_en: The model is trained and serving; you want to add fairness calibration without retraining the whole model.
q: 哪种方案最部署友好？
q_en: Which approach is most deployment-friendly?
why: 按群体做后处理校准最友好：它只作用在已训练模型的输出上、无需重训。工作流是训一个模型 → 用分层留出集给每个群体各拟合一个校准器 → 服务时按群体路由概率再进决策。Meta/Google 广告本就为出价做校准，扩到 per-group 只是加路由层+群参数。
why_en: Per-group post-processing calibration is most deployment-friendly because it operates on a trained model's outputs with no retraining.
tradeoff: 后处理校准（无需重训、加路由层即可）vs in-processing/重训（改模型本身，成本高、周期长）
whenOtherWins: 如果偏差深植于表征、后处理调不动，就得上 in-processing（如 adversarial debiasing）从训练阶段改。
options: 重新训练整个模型并加入公平约束
按群体做后处理校准，只作用于已训模型输出、无需重训，服务时按群体路由
换一个更大的模型架构，让它自己学公平
在训练损失里加对抗项做 adversarial debiasing
options_en: Retrain the entire model with fairness constraints added.
Per-group post-processing calibration that operates on the trained model's outputs with no retraining, routing by group at serving.
Swap to a bigger architecture and let it learn fairness itself.
Add an adversarial term to the training loss for adversarial debiasing.
optionExplanations: 重训成本高、周期长，不是『最部署友好』；题目正是要避免重训。
对；后处理校准零重训、只加路由层+群参数，Meta/Google 广告已有校准基础，扩展最轻。
换大模型要重训且不保证公平，反而更重，不满足部署友好。
adversarial debiasing 是 in-processing，需要改训练、对超参极敏感，比后处理重得多。
optionExplanations_en: Retraining is costly and slow — not 'most deployment-friendly'; the prompt wants to avoid retraining.
Correct — post-processing calibration needs zero retraining, just a routing layer plus group params, and ad systems already calibrate, so extension is lightest.
A bigger model requires retraining and doesn't guarantee fairness — heavier, not deployment-friendly.
Adversarial debiasing is in-processing, changes training, and is hyperparameter-sensitive — far heavier than post-processing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在已训练模型的输出上按群体调整概率，无需重训模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Post-processing calibration adjusts a trained model's output probabilities per group without retraining.

scenario: 要给每个群体各拟合一个概率校准器，在 Platt scaling 和 isotonic regression 之间选。
scenario_en: Fitting one probability calibrator per group, you choose between Platt scaling and isotonic regression.
q: Platt scaling 与 isotonic regression 该怎么选？
q_en: How to choose between Platt scaling and isotonic regression?
why: Platt scaling 是在原始分数上做逻辑回归，参数少、数据需求小、适合近似 sigmoid 的偏差；isotonic regression 是非参数单调拟合，能处理非线性 miscalibration 但需要更多数据。数据少选 Platt，非线性且数据够选 isotonic。
why_en: Platt scaling is a parametric logistic fit needing little data for sigmoid-like miscalibration, while isotonic regression is non-parametric and monotonic, handling non-linear miscalibration but needing more data.
tradeoff: Platt scaling（参数少、数据省，但只拟合 sigmoid 形）vs isotonic（非参数、能拟合非线性，但要更多数据）
options: Platt scaling 非参数、要大量数据；isotonic 参数化、数据省
Platt scaling 参数少、数据省、拟合 sigmoid 形；isotonic 非参数单调、能拟合非线性但要更多数据
两者等价，随便选一个即可
isotonic 只能用于回归，不能做概率校准
options_en: Platt scaling is non-parametric needing lots of data; isotonic is parametric and data-thrifty.
Platt scaling is parametric, data-thrifty, fits sigmoid-shaped bias; isotonic is non-parametric monotonic, handles non-linearity but needs more data.
They're equivalent — pick either.
Isotonic works only for regression, not probability calibration.
optionExplanations: 说反了：Platt 是参数化、省数据，isotonic 才是非参数、要更多数据。
对；数据少或偏差近 sigmoid 用 Platt，偏差非线性且群体数据够就用 isotonic。
两者数据需求和拟合能力不同，不能随便选——小群体用 isotonic 容易过拟合。
isotonic 常用于概率校准（单调映射原始分到校准概率），此说法错误。
optionExplanations_en: Reversed: Platt is parametric and data-thrifty; isotonic is the non-parametric one needing more data.
Correct — use Platt for little data or sigmoid-like bias, isotonic for non-linear bias when a group has enough data.
They differ in data needs and flexibility — not interchangeable; isotonic overfits small groups.
Isotonic is commonly used for probability calibration (monotonic mapping of raw scores to calibrated probs); the claim is false.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在模型原始分数上拟合一个逻辑回归，把分数映射成校准概率，参数少。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Platt scaling fits a logistic regression on raw model scores to map them to calibrated probabilities, with few parameters.

termDefinitions.meaning: 非参数的单调拟合，把原始分映射成校准概率，能处理非线性偏差但需更多数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Isotonic regression is a non-parametric monotonic fit mapping raw scores to calibrated probabilities, handling non-linear bias but needing more data.

q: 把 per-group 后处理校准的工作流排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the per-group post-processing calibration workflow:
steps: 服务时按每条预测的群体身份路由到对应校准器，再进决策系统
在全量数据上训练一个模型
为每个群体在留出数据上各拟合一个校准器（Platt/isotonic）
留出一个按群体分层的校准集
why: 顺序：全量训一个模型 → 留出按群体分层的校准集 → 每群体各拟合一个校准器 → 服务时按群体路由概率再进决策。只训一个模型，公平性靠 per-group 的校准器和路由层实现。
why_en: Train one model on all data, hold out a group-stratified calibration set, fit one calibrator per group, then at serving route each prediction through its group calibrator.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从数据中留出、按群体分层的样本集，专门用来拟合每群体的校准器。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A calibration set is held-out, group-stratified data used solely to fit each group's calibrator.

scenario: per-group 校准在服务时要按群体路由，但用户的群体身份（如种族）在推理时可能拿不到或涉及隐私。
scenario_en: Per-group calibration routes by group at serving, but a user's group membership (e.g. race) may be unavailable or privacy-sensitive at inference.
q: per-group 校准的主要落地代价是什么？
q_en: What's the main deployment cost of per-group calibration?
why: 代价是推理时需要群体成员身份来选校准器，而它常常拿不到或隐私敏感。没有标签时只能用代理/贝叶斯近似群体身份，这会引入额外误差，削弱校准效果。
why_en: It needs group membership at inference to pick the calibrator, which is often unavailable or privacy-sensitive, forcing proxy/Bayesian approximation that adds error.
tradeoff: 有群体标签（校准精准，但需采集敏感属性）vs 无标签用代理/贝叶斯近似（保护隐私，但引入误差）
options: 需要重训模型，成本很高
推理时需要群体成员身份来路由，而它常拿不到或隐私敏感；用代理近似会引入误差
校准器太大，拖慢在线延迟到不可用
只能用于二分类，无法扩展到多分类
options_en: It requires retraining the model, which is expensive.
It needs group membership at inference to route, which is often unavailable or privacy-sensitive; proxy approximation adds error.
The calibrators are so large they slow online latency to unusable levels.
It only works for binary classification and can't extend to multi-class.
optionExplanations: 后处理校准恰恰不用重训，这不是它的代价。
对；真正的落地难点是推理时要知道群体身份，隐私/可得性受限，近似又引入误差。
校准器（逻辑回归/保序映射）极轻量，不会造成延迟问题。
校准可扩展到多类/多群体，不是二分类专属限制。
optionExplanations_en: Post-processing calibration precisely avoids retraining — that's not its cost.
Correct — the real hurdle is needing group membership at inference, limited by privacy/availability, with approximation adding error.
Calibrators (logistic/monotonic maps) are tiny and cause no latency issue.
Calibration extends to multi-class/multi-group; it's not a binary-only limitation.

scenario: 给模型加上更严格的公平约束后，整体准确率下降了，团队争论这是不是 bug。
scenario_en: After adding stricter fairness constraints, overall accuracy drops, and the team debates whether it's a bug.
q: 公平约束导致准确率下降，该怎么理解和决策？
q_en: How to understand and decide on the accuracy drop from fairness constraints?
why: 不是 bug：无约束模型会利用与群体相关的特征换取准确率，加公平约束就削掉这部分，形成准确率-公平违背的 Pareto 前沿。选哪个操作点是伦理/业务决策，由法务/产品/政策一起定，不是纯技术最优。
why_en: It's expected: the unconstrained model exploits group-correlated features, so fairness forms an accuracy-versus-violation Pareto frontier, and the operating point is an ethical stakeholder decision.
tradeoff: 更严公平（准确率降，但违背小）vs 更松/无约束（准确率高，但利用群体相关特征、违背大）
options: 是 bug，公平约束不该降准确率，应回滚
是预期取舍：无约束模型靠群体相关特征换准确率，形成 Pareto 前沿，操作点由利益相关者伦理决策
说明公平约束无用，直接去掉追求最高准确率
加大模型容量就能同时拿到最高准确率和最强公平
options_en: It's a bug — fairness constraints shouldn't lower accuracy, so roll back.
It's an expected tradeoff: the unconstrained model buys accuracy with group-correlated features, forming a Pareto frontier whose operating point is an ethical stakeholder decision.
It proves fairness constraints are useless — drop them and chase maximum accuracy.
Just add model capacity to get both maximum accuracy and maximum fairness.
optionExplanations: 下降是数学上预期的，不是 bug；回滚等于放弃公平目标。
对；这是准确率-公平的 Pareto 取舍，选点是伦理决策，需法务/产品/政策共定。
去掉约束追准确率就是牺牲公平，恰恰忽略了监管与伦理要求。
加容量改变不了这个取舍的本质，Pareto 前沿依旧存在，不能『既要又要』。
optionExplanations_en: The drop is mathematically expected, not a bug; rolling back abandons the fairness goal.
Correct — it's an accuracy-fairness Pareto tradeoff, and choosing the point is an ethical decision co-set by legal/product/policy.
Dropping constraints for accuracy sacrifices fairness, ignoring regulatory and ethical requirements.
Adding capacity doesn't change the tradeoff's nature; the Pareto frontier remains — you can't have both maxed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 准确率与公平违背之间不可同时改进的最优权衡曲线，每点是一个操作选择。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Pareto frontier is the curve of optimal accuracy-vs-fairness-violation tradeoffs where neither can improve without worsening the other.

scenario: 后处理校准调不动深层偏差，想在训练阶段就让表征不携带群体信息。
scenario_en: Post-processing can't reach deep bias; you want representations that carry no group info at training time.
q: 该用哪种 in-processing 方法，它的主要风险是什么？
q_en: Which in-processing method fits, and what's its main risk?
why: 用 adversarial debiasing：主模型学对预测有用的表征，一个对抗判别器试图从表征猜群体身份，训练让表征『对预测有用、对群体不可判』。风险是对超参（约束权重、对抗器学习率）极敏感，必须做充分的超参扫描。
why_en: Use adversarial debiasing so representations are useful for prediction but uninformative about group, with the main risk being extreme hyperparameter sensitivity requiring thorough sweeps.
tradeoff: adversarial debiasing（从表征根除群体信号，但超参极敏感、训练难调）vs 后处理校准（易部署但够不到深层偏差）
whenOtherWins: 如果偏差只是输出层的概率偏移、且模型已上线不便重训，后处理校准更省事，不必上对抗训练。
options: 换更大数据集重训，偏差自然消失，无需特殊方法
adversarial debiasing：表征对预测有用、对群体不可判；风险是对超参极敏感、需充分扫参
直接把群体标签加进特征，让模型显式建模
只做后处理校准就够，in-processing 没有必要
options_en: Retrain on a bigger dataset and the bias vanishes — no special method needed.
Adversarial debiasing: representations useful for prediction but uninformative about group; the risk is extreme hyperparameter sensitivity requiring thorough sweeps.
Just add the group label as a feature so the model models it explicitly.
Post-processing calibration alone suffices; in-processing is unnecessary.
optionExplanations: 更大数据集不针对偏差，若数据本身带偏，规模只会放大而非消除。
对；adversarial debiasing 用对抗器逼表征丢掉群体信号，代价是超参极敏感、要认真扫参。
把群体标签加进特征方向反了，会强化模型对群体的依赖。
题设已说后处理够不到深层偏差，正需要 in-processing，不能一概而论说没必要。
optionExplanations_en: A bigger dataset doesn't target bias; if the data is biased, scale amplifies rather than removes it.
Correct — adversarial debiasing uses a discriminator to strip group signal from representations, at the cost of extreme hyperparameter sensitivity needing careful sweeps.
Adding the group label as a feature is backwards, reinforcing the model's reliance on group.
The prompt says post-processing can't reach the deep bias, so in-processing is exactly needed — not universally unnecessary.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时加一个试图从表征预测群体身份的对抗器，逼主模型学到不含群体信息的表征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Adversarial debiasing adds an adversary that tries to predict group from the representation, forcing the main model to learn group-uninformative representations.

scenario: 招聘广告模型给女性展示的职位广告更少，随后观察到的点击也更少。
scenario_en: A job-ad model shows fewer ads to women, and subsequently observes fewer clicks from them.
q: 这里的反馈环偏差是怎么自我放大的？
q_en: How does this feedback-loop bias self-amplify?
why: 偏模型 → 偏预测 → 偏采集的下一批数据 → 强化偏见。展示少→观测点击少→预测 CTR 更低→投放更少→差距每次重训都拉大，形成放大差异的正反馈环。
why_en: A biased model yields biased predictions, which bias the next collected data, reinforcing the bias each retraining cycle.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["偏模型"] --> P["给女性展示更少"]
  P --> C["观测点击更少"]
  C --> L["预测 CTR 更低"]
  L --> D["投放更少"]
  D --> M
options: 偏见会随每次重训自动被稀释，环最终收敛到公平
偏模型→偏预测→偏采集数据→强化偏见：展示少→点击少→预测 CTR 更低→投放更少，差距每轮拉大
反馈环只影响准确率，不影响群体公平
只要模型准确率高，反馈环就不会出现
options_en: The bias auto-dilutes each retraining and the loop converges to fairness.
Biased model to biased predictions to biased collected data reinforces bias: fewer shown to fewer clicks to lower predicted CTR to less delivery, widening the gap each cycle.
The feedback loop only affects accuracy, not group fairness.
As long as accuracy is high, the feedback loop won't appear.
optionExplanations: 恰恰相反，这是正反馈——不干预会越训越偏，不会自动收敛到公平。
对；展示少导致观测点击少，模型误以为女性 CTR 低，投放进一步减少，差距逐轮放大。
反馈环放大的正是群体间的 demographic-parity 差距，直接是公平问题。
高准确率也可能困在有偏数据的自我强化里，准确率高不等于无反馈环偏差。
optionExplanations_en: The opposite — it's positive feedback: without intervention it worsens each cycle, not converging to fairness.
Correct — fewer impressions cause fewer observed clicks, the model infers low female CTR, delivery shrinks further, and the gap widens each cycle.
The loop amplifies exactly the inter-group demographic-parity gap — a fairness problem directly.
High accuracy can still be trapped in self-reinforcing biased data; high accuracy doesn't preclude feedback-loop bias.

termDefinitions.term: feedback loop bias / 反馈环偏差
termDefinitions.meaning: 偏模型影响下一批采集数据，形成越训越偏的正反馈，放大群体差异。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Feedback-loop bias is when a biased model shapes the next data it collects, a positive feedback that worsens group disparities each retraining.

scenario: 怀疑广告投放系统存在反馈环偏差，想在它把差距拉得过大之前发现它。
scenario_en: You suspect feedback-loop bias in an ad system and want to catch it before the gap grows too large.
q: 怎么检测反馈环是否在起作用？
q_en: How do you detect whether the feedback loop is active?
why: 跨连续重训周期监控公平指标：如果 demographic-parity 差距随每次重训单调变大，说明反馈环在放大差异。单看一次快照看不出来，趋势才是信号。
why_en: Monitor fairness metrics across successive retraining cycles — a monotonically widening demographic-parity gap signals an active loop.
tradeoff: 跨周期监控趋势（能捕捉放大动态）vs 单次快照（只看一个版本，漏掉反馈环）
whenOtherWins: 如果系统不重训、或不用自身产出的数据再训练（无闭环），就不存在这种放大动态，跨周期监控意义不大。
options: 看单次评估的 aggregate 准确率是否达标
跨连续重训周期监控公平指标：demographic-parity 差距单调变大 → 反馈环在放大差异
只在用户投诉后做一次性审计
看模型参数量有没有增长
options_en: Check whether a single evaluation's aggregate accuracy passes.
Monitor fairness metrics across successive retraining cycles: a monotonically widening demographic-parity gap means the loop is amplifying disparities.
Only run a one-off audit after user complaints.
Check whether the model's parameter count grew.
optionExplanations: 单次 aggregate 准确率看不出跨周期的放大趋势，反馈环恰恰藏在时间维度里。
对；反馈环是时间动态，只有跨重训周期追踪公平差距的趋势才抓得住。
事后一次性审计太晚，等投诉时差距已被放大多轮。
参数量和反馈环偏差无关，抓错了信号。
optionExplanations_en: A single aggregate accuracy can't reveal cross-cycle amplification; the loop hides in the time dimension.
Correct — the loop is a temporal dynamic, caught only by tracking the fairness gap's trend across retraining cycles.
A post-hoc one-off audit is too late; by complaint time the gap has amplified over many cycles.
Parameter count is unrelated to feedback-loop bias — wrong signal.

scenario: 确认广告系统存在反馈环偏差，要选缓解手段。
scenario_en: Having confirmed feedback-loop bias in the ad system, you select mitigations.
q: 文中给出的反馈环缓解手段有哪些？(多选)
q_en: Which feedback-loop mitigations does the lesson give? (multiple)
why: 三招：① 探索策略（epsilon-greedy/Thompson sampling 保证各群体最低曝光，打破『没展示就没数据』）；② 反事实日志（记录一个公平策略本会怎么做，用于离策略评估、不真正上线伤害）；③ 去偏重训（重加权/重采样抵消已累积的偏斜）。
why_en: Exploration policies for minimum exposure, counterfactual logging for off-policy evaluation, and debiased retraining that reweights/resamples to counteract accumulated skew.
options: 探索策略（epsilon-greedy/Thompson sampling）保证各群体最低曝光
反事实日志：记录公平策略本会怎么做，用于离策略评估而不真正上线伤害
去偏重训：重加权/重采样抵消已累积的偏斜
直接删掉少数群体的样本，让数据更干净
options_en: Exploration policies (epsilon-greedy/Thompson sampling) to guarantee minimum exposure across groups.
Counterfactual logging: record what a fair policy would do, for off-policy evaluation without deploying harm.
Debiased retraining: reweight/resample to counteract accumulated skew.
Just delete the minority group's samples to make the data cleaner.
optionExplanations: 对；探索策略强制给每个群体最低曝光，打破『没展示→没数据→更不展示』的环。
对；反事实日志离线记录公平策略的动作，能评估而不真的部署有害策略。
对；去偏重训在训练侧重加权/重采样，抵消历史数据里累积的偏斜。
错；删掉少数群体样本会加剧代表性不足，让反馈环更严重，方向完全相反。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — exploration forces minimum exposure per group, breaking the 'no impression to no data to even less' loop.
Correct — counterfactual logging records a fair policy's actions offline, enabling evaluation without deploying a harmful policy.
Correct — debiased retraining reweights/resamples on the training side to counteract accumulated skew.
Incorrect — deleting minority samples worsens under-representation and the loop — the exact opposite direction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 记录一个假想的公平策略本会采取的动作，用于离策略评估而不真正部署。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Counterfactual logging records the actions a hypothetical fair policy would take, enabling off-policy evaluation without deploying it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用已有日志数据评估一个未真正上线的新策略的表现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Off-policy evaluation estimates how a new, not-yet-deployed policy would perform using existing logged data.

scenario: 反馈环的根子在『没给某群体展示→就没有它的点击数据→模型更不给它展示』。
scenario_en: The loop's root is 'don't show a group to get no click data to show it even less'.
q: 哪种缓解手段直接打破这个『没数据』的死循环？
q_en: Which mitigation directly breaks the 'no data' vicious cycle?
why: 用探索策略（epsilon-greedy 或 Thompson sampling）保证每个群体都有最低曝光量，从而持续采集到各群体的反馈数据，打破『没展示就没数据』。它以少量短期收益换长期数据均衡与公平。
why_en: Exploration policies (epsilon-greedy/Thompson sampling) guarantee minimum exposure per group so data keeps flowing, breaking the no-data cycle.
tradeoff: 探索保证最低曝光（打破死循环，代价是牺牲少量短期指标）vs 纯利用（短期指标最优，但固化反馈环）
whenOtherWins: 如果各群体已有充足且均衡的反馈数据、不存在采集缺口，纯利用（exploit）短期收益更高，不必额外探索。
options: 把模型准确率再调高，数据自然会均衡
用探索策略（epsilon-greedy/Thompson sampling）保证各群体最低曝光，持续采到反馈数据
冻结模型不再重训，环就停了
把所有群体合并成一个群体，消除差异
options_en: Just raise model accuracy and the data will balance itself.
Use exploration policies (epsilon-greedy/Thompson sampling) to guarantee minimum exposure per group, keeping feedback data flowing.
Freeze the model and stop retraining so the loop halts.
Merge all groups into one to erase the disparity.
optionExplanations: 调准确率不解决采集缺口，有偏数据下准确率高反而固化偏见。
对；探索强制给每个群体最低曝光，重新引入其反馈数据，直接打断『没展示→没数据』。
冻结模型只是停在当前偏见上，不修正已有差距，也没恢复缺失群体的数据。
合并群体是掩盖差异不是消除，反而让公平监控失去分辨率。
optionExplanations_en: Tuning accuracy doesn't fix the data gap; on biased data, high accuracy entrenches the bias.
Correct — exploration forces minimum exposure per group, reintroducing their feedback data and directly breaking 'no impression to no data'.
Freezing the model just locks in current bias, neither correcting the gap nor restoring missing-group data.
Merging groups hides the disparity rather than removing it and destroys fairness-monitoring resolution.

termDefinitions.meaning: 以概率 ε 随机探索、其余时间选当前最优的策略，用来保证探索量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Epsilon-greedy explores randomly with probability ε and exploits the current best otherwise, ensuring some exploration.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按各选项『可能最优』的后验概率抽样来平衡探索与利用的策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Thompson sampling picks actions in proportion to their posterior probability of being optimal, balancing exploration and exploitation.

scenario: 面试里被问『为什么公平性要在设计阶段就当硬需求，而不是上线后再说』。
scenario_en: In an interview you're asked why fairness must be a hard requirement at design time, not after launch.
q: 哪些监管在推动把公平当设计需求？
q_en: Which regulators push fairness as a design requirement?
why: EEOC（就业机会均等）、ECOA（信贷机会均等）、EU AI Act 等越来越要求提供非歧视性影响的证据。这意味着公平不是上线后可选项，而是要在设计阶段就留下可审计的证明。
why_en: EEOC, ECOA, and the EU AI Act increasingly require evidence of non-discriminatory impact, making fairness a design-time, auditable requirement.
options: 只有内部伦理委员会关心，没有外部法律约束
EEOC、ECOA、EU AI Act 等要求非歧视性影响的证据，公平须在设计阶段可审计
GDPR 只管数据隐私，和公平完全无关，无监管推动
监管只针对模型准确率，不涉及群体公平
options_en: Only internal ethics boards care; there's no external legal pressure.
EEOC, ECOA, and the EU AI Act require evidence of non-discriminatory impact, so fairness must be auditable at design time.
GDPR only covers data privacy and is unrelated to fairness — no regulatory pressure.
Regulation targets only model accuracy, not group fairness.
optionExplanations: 外部法律约束确实存在，EEOC/ECOA/EU AI Act 都在施压，不只是内部伦理。
对；这些监管要求非歧视影响的证据，逼公平前置为设计阶段的可审计需求。
就业/信贷/AI 专门法规都直接触及公平，说『无监管推动』不成立。
监管关注的正是群体公平与非歧视影响，不止准确率。
optionExplanations_en: External legal pressure does exist — EEOC/ECOA/EU AI Act all apply, not just internal ethics.
Correct — these regulators demand evidence of non-discriminatory impact, forcing fairness to be a design-time auditable requirement.
Employment/credit/AI-specific laws directly touch fairness, so 'no regulatory pressure' is false.
Regulators focus precisely on group fairness and non-discriminatory impact, not only accuracy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 美国就业机会均等委员会，监管招聘等场景的歧视问题。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The EEOC (Equal Employment Opportunity Commission) is the US agency regulating employment discrimination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 美国信贷机会均等法，禁止信贷决策中的歧视。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ECOA (Equal Credit Opportunity Act) is the US law prohibiting discrimination in credit decisions.

scenario: 面试做广告/推荐系统的评估设计，想给出 senior/staff 级的公平性洞察。
scenario_en: Designing evaluation for an ads/rec system in an interview, you want senior/staff-level fairness insight.
q: 提哪两点最能体现资深级的公平性思维？
q_en: Which two points best show senior-level fairness thinking?
why: 两个 staff 级信号：① 点出 calibration 与 equalized odds 的不可能定理（base rate 不同时必须取舍）；② 主动提反馈环监控 + 探索缓解，展示对长期动态的意识。二者都超越『算个公平指标』，触及取舍与时间演化。
why_en: Cite the calibration-versus-equalized-odds impossibility result and propose feedback-loop monitoring plus exploration mitigation, showing awareness of tradeoffs and long-term dynamics.
options: 承诺同时满足所有公平指标，并把准确率也做到最高
点明 calibration 与 equalized odds 的不可能定理，并提反馈环监控 + 探索缓解长期动态
只报告一个 demographic-parity 数字就结束
强调只要删掉受保护属性特征就万事大吉
options_en: Promise to satisfy all fairness metrics at once and also maximize accuracy.
Cite the calibration-vs-equalized-odds impossibility result and propose feedback-loop monitoring plus exploration to mitigate long-term dynamics.
Report a single demographic-parity number and stop.
Insist that dropping the protected-attribute feature solves everything.
optionExplanations: 承诺全都满足恰恰暴露不懂不可能定理，是反信号。
对；不可能定理体现取舍意识、反馈环监控体现长期动态意识，都是资深级洞察。
只报一个数字停在最浅层，没有取舍也没有动态视角。
只删属性是 unawareness 谬误，代理会泄漏，反而暴露理解不足。
optionExplanations_en: Promising to satisfy all at once exposes ignorance of the impossibility result — a negative signal.
Correct — the impossibility result shows tradeoff awareness and feedback-loop monitoring shows long-term-dynamics awareness, both senior insights.
Reporting one number stops at the shallowest level, with no tradeoff or dynamics lens.
Dropping the attribute alone is the unawareness fallacy — proxies leak, exposing a shallow grasp.
